talkwheel.jaymoskingdoms.jaymoskingdoms_: I'd like to see to my account.
bank.jaymoskingdoms.greet: The bank of %s. Your account holds %s.
bank.jaymoskingdoms.greet_loan: The bank of %s. Your account holds %s, and you owe us %s, due in %s days.
bank.jaymoskingdoms.letter: A letter of credit for all of it (%s)
bank.jaymoskingdoms.cash: Cash the letter in your hand (%s)
bank.jaymoskingdoms.vault_short: "That's all the coin in the vault of %s just now." The rest stays on your books until it fills again.
bank.jaymoskingdoms.vault_bare: "The vault of %s is bare: the coin has been spent." Your balance stays on the books.
bank.jaymoskingdoms.letter_drawn: A letter of credit for %s, drawn on the bank of %s, payable to you alone.
bank.jaymoskingdoms.not_yours: "This isn't drawn in your name." The teller hands it back.
bank.jaymoskingdoms.waste_paper: The bank of %s is no more. The letter is waste paper, and the teller drops it in the brazier.
bank.jaymoskingdoms.letter_unpaid: "The bank of %s can't honour this just now: its vault is short." The teller hands the letter back.
bank.jaymoskingdoms.inherited: %s is gone, and you are their next of kin: %s of theirs is yours at the bank of %s.
bank.jaymoskingdoms.borrowed: Lent you %s. You owe %s, due in %s days.
bank.jaymoskingdoms.repaid: Repaid %s. You owe the bank nothing.
bank.jaymoskingdoms.overdue: Your loan from the bank of %s is overdue: %s still owed, and your name suffers for it every day.
bank.jaymoskingdoms.fell: The bank where you kept %s fell with its realm. The money went with it.
